We walk past the 8-9 min mile section, and then the 10-11...we figure we're pretty slow, so we stand in the 12+ area such that we don't get in the way of real runners. There's like, nobody with us. Big crowds in all the faster starting areas, but we're almost the only ones at the 12+. We're like crap, we suuuuuuuck.

Anyway, our wave is about to start, and the announcer makes a point of saying that walkers should walk on the right, so as not to get in the way. We stand all the way to the left because fuck that, we don't stop or walk..,that's part of the challenge.

So the 10k starts and we settle into a nice tempo. The next hour consists of dodging fatties as they walk or waddle directly in front of us...sometimes multiple manatees abreast, blocking the way. We eventually finished with nary a mayochugger in sight, at a pace of 10:45 minutes per mile. So we jogged it. But at least we kept going steadily and never slowed down. And we enjoyed it. The scenery just got better and better, like clawing our way out of the pits of the part of hell that deals with the gluttony of man.
